deadline.intake: Autumn 2027 (2027/2028 round opens 1 Dec 2026); non-EU/EFTA applicants; 1 July for EU/EFTA and visa-free applicants

tuition.note: Global Marketing (English-taught bachelor's), state non-funded place, per year; fees vary by programme

requirement.text: Completed secondary education with an overall average of at least 60%, no more than five years since graduation for non-EU/EFTA applicants, English certificate at B2 or higher (IELTS Academic 6.5 listed for Global Marketing), a reference and a motivation letter; shortlisted candidates have a motivational interview. Application fee EUR 100.
